english: Do you do anything else down here? A hobby?
Why should I tell you anything?
I do tend to some gardening duty as well.
Keeping the dampness to an appropriate level. And communing with Lord Puu when the Dark Elf requires it.
You've got a green thumb, eh?
You get to fight a lot of monsters down here?
I have no interest in magic, and its foul nature.
No. But I serve well, nonetheless.
They often break into the upper City Below.
It is mostly minor monsters. Sometimes a large one.
At times undead. Fought a ghoul last month. Easy kill, not too interesting.
It is my great pleasure - to best a dangerous foe.
Her smile is horrific and bright.
I do not LOOK like it, human.
(Nod.) "I agree. A lot. Like, a lot, a lot."
She laughs, mockingly. "Some type of courtship? You are a fool!"
Prove yourself worthy, and I might look your way. You buffoon.
Oh, that's what every girl wants. Having to tell someone how to court her.
In a way that makes you shiver.
Hm. Did you have anything to say, warrior?
Oh boy. Mind control is fun!
Tell me something useful about that area.
You wouldn't be into scrawny human men, would you?
How angry would you get if somebody cast Charm Person on you?
There's traps everywhere. Some undead tend to wander in the crypts nearby.
The southern tunnels are filled with monsters, crawling up from further Below.
The northern tunnels are safer, but not by much.
There's also a Crocodilus camped in the sewers, last I heard. Not the type you want to mess with.
I'm sure you'll be fine though, human.
She laughs, and slaps you on the back.
They are HWBT. I cannot give them away.
Even if I ask really nicely.
She laughs. "I like you, Cleric. But no."
I like a man who stops at nothing to fight for me.
One who throws himself into battle for my approval alone.
Though then again, a slave isn't such a bad idea either. Maybe I'll have one of those too.
There was a man dressed in yellow who did it not long ago. If I get my hands on him, I'll strangle him. That should be a suitable death.
Any dangerous lurking beyond will surely be slain by your capable hands.
If you walk past her, the charm will eventually run out.
Then she will simply chase you down and beat you senseless.
Great! I'll go then. (Walk past her.)
Beyond you see a deep, overgrown chamber, filled with... roots.
You see the chamber open up before you- a vast misty tangle of roots unveiling a cacophony of-
Rushing towards you with intense speed, the bugbear appears but a moment later, brandishing her weapon, readying a full swing.
The last thing you see is the mace heading towards your-
She tosses your half-corpse onto the hard tiles.
I would gladly rip the throat out of wicked sorcerers like you, human.
But alas, I am not allowed. So be happy I simply struck you once.
As soon as the spell fades, the bugbear rushes into action.
You have no idea how much I would love to throw away my orders right now.
But you see, unfortunately I'm not allowed to rip out the throats of any old fool who wanders down here.
So consider yourself blessed by the gods today, human. For you get to live to see another day.
She lets you go, pushing you back.
The bugbear's massive hand clamps around your wrist like a vice.
Her grip tightens. You feel bones shifting.
Dishonorable. Shameful. This is what you've become.
I wasn't stealing! I was... merely inspecting.
I'm sorry. It won't happen again.
Let go of me. I am a cleric of the city.
I saw you reach forward, grab, and then attempt to PULL this, right in front of my face?!
You are a thief who happens to wear Urthguard colors.
That makes it worse, not better.
You attempt to wriggle out of her grip.
Her other hand grabs your collar.
Now you're even more trapped. Great work.
She pulls you close. Close enough to smell her breath.
Do it then. Break them. (Stare her down.)
What do you want? Crowns? I can pay.
Seconds pass. Her grip does not loosen.
But something shifts in her eyes.
She releases you with a shove.
You have spine, thief. I'll give you that.
But if I catch you again...
She draws a claw across her throat.
A grin spreads across her face.
She scoffs. "You think I can be bought?"
I am not some corrupt city guard, human.
Your companion gives you a helpless shrug.
I told you not to mess with her, he whispers.
Lady Sageleaf has rules about thieves on Halfway territory.
It's the size of your face.
Her grip holds you in place.
Steal from me again, and I will take the hand.
She does not hate you. She is only making sure you don't hurt yourself.
(Stay on the ground for a moment.)
Get up, thief. You're embarrassing yourself.
She returns to her post, eyeing you with disgust.
You will get back at her for this.
Do not test me again, human.
